hero.lead: Manage boat trips, calculate shares, and track expenses effortlessly. The ultimate financial operating system for sand and limestone business in Bangladesh.

features.title: Built for River Transport
features.subtitle: Everything you need to manage your sand and stone business in one place.
features.fleetDesc: Track boat details, capacities, engine status, and comprehensive maintenance logs.
features.accountingDesc: Log barki purchase costs, sale amounts, and calculate your net profit instantly.
features.tollsDesc: Easily separate official government lease royalties (ইজারা) and local tolls (টোল) from operating expenses.
features.expensesDesc: Maintain itemized logs for fuel, labour, maintenance, and loading fees in real-time.

workflow.title: How It Works
workflow.subtitle: Simplify your operations in three easy steps
workflow.step1Desc: Assign a boat, log your source ghat, and track sand (barki) loading costs.
workflow.step2Desc: Record tolls, fuel costs, and labour expenses on the go.
workflow.step3Desc: Deliver cargo, settle Mahajan commissions, and instantly see your net profit.

cta.title: Ready to modernize your business?
cta.subtitle: Join the digital revolution of Bangladesh's river transport industry today.
